leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript discriminated union type to define component props with distinct variants
Implement a React component that accepts and destructures discriminated union props
Configure conditional rendering logic based on the discriminant property of union props
Initialize and manipulate component state that works with discriminated union prop variants
Apply type narrowing techniques to safely access variant-specific properties within handlers
Integrate event handlers that update UI based on the active discriminated union variant
Render multiple component instances with different discriminated union prop configurations
